operations.name: Establish a Spy Network
operations.description: Recruit the first agents in a foreign capital. Cheap and safe, but it only plants the seed: the network must be grown before it can do real work.

operations.name: Deep-Cover Expansion
operations.description: Push an established network deep into ministries and general staffs. A long, expensive investment that pays off in a far larger and more durable network.

operations.name: Steal Research
operations.description: Have agents lift blueprints and test data from the target's laboratories and pass them to our own scientists.

operations.name: Industrial Espionage
operations.description: A large-scale penetration of the target's design bureaus, trading a long exposure window for a windfall of research progress.

operations.name: Sabotage Factories
operations.description: Bomb a key plant and corrupt its tooling. Output drops for a season while the damage is repaired.

operations.name: Strike the Rail Network
operations.description: Cut marshalling yards and bridges behind the front. A larger operation with a larger and longer industrial toll.

operations.name: Fund a Political Movement
operations.description: Channel money and propaganda to a sympathetic faction so that it grows at the expense of the ruling party.

operations.name: Destabilise the Government
operations.description: Strikes, riots and forged scandals strain the target's internal order for months.

operations.name: Counter-Intelligence Sweep
operations.description: Turn the service inward: tail suspected enemy agents, roll up their letter drops and burn the networks inside our own borders.

operations.name: Internal Security Directorate
operations.description: A standing organisation to hunt foreign agents at home. It defends the actor: it never touches the target country's stability or output.

agency_upgrades.name: Intelligence Academy
agency_upgrades.description: A permanent school for case officers. Doubles the peacetime rate at which a spy network grows.

agency_upgrades.name: Station Chiefs
agency_upgrades.description: Professional resident chiefs in every capital give counter-intelligence a standing head start against enemy networks at home.

agency_upgrades.name: Radio Interception Service
agency_upgrades.description: Listening posts and traffic analysis double the pace at which foreign ciphers are broken.

agency_upgrades.name: Agent Infiltration
agency_upgrades.description: Better cover identities and cut-outs add another half to the base network growth rate, on top of the academy.

agency_upgrades.name: Special Operations Executive
agency_upgrades.description: A body that plans and speeds covert action: operations run at double pace, at a real political-power cost.

agency_upgrades.name: Cipher Bureau
agency_upgrades.description: A dedicated cryptanalysis bureau adds another half to decryption speed; the machine methods only work once the interception service exists.

agency_upgrades.name: Counter-Intelligence Expansion
agency_upgrades.description: Wartime expansion of the security services; the standing counter-intelligence level grows further.

agency_upgrades.name: Resident Network
agency_upgrades.description: Long-settled residents rather than travelling agents. A large further increase in network growth, expensive and slow to build.

agency_upgrades.name: Commando Section
agency_upgrades.description: Trained field teams to execute the plans the executive draws up: operations run at triple pace once both are owned.

agency_upgrades.name: Decryption Department
agency_upgrades.description: A late expansion of the cipher bureau, bringing total decryption speed to twice the 1936 base.

agency_upgrades.name: Deep Cover Section
agency_upgrades.description: The service's final reach: network growth rises to twice the base rate again, gated behind the resident networks.

agency_upgrades.name: Directorate of Operations
agency_upgrades.description: A single command for covert action. Operations run at triple the base pace, at the highest political-power price in the tree.

agency_upgrades.name: National Security Agency
agency_upgrades.description: A unified signals and security service. The standing counter-intelligence level reaches its wartime ceiling.
